sloka: ताः प्रजा देवदेवेशं राजार्थं समुपाद्रवन् ।सुराणां स्थापितो राजा त्वया देव शतक्रतुः ।। ७.७६.३८ ॥
transliteration: tāḥ prajā devadeveśaṁ rājārthaṁ samupādravan ।surāṇāṁ sthāpito rājā tvayā deva śatakratuḥ ।। 7.76.38 ॥

translations.english: Those people approached the Lord of gods (Brahma) requesting a king, reminding him that he had already established Indra as the king of the gods.
